content.rendered: These all still have “once per lifetime” language now, right? Or can you get an Ink Preferred if you’ve gotten an Ink Cash in the past?

Yes, Once-In-A-Lifetime language on all of them, so you’ll need to die first and get resurrected before you can take advantage of any of these offers. Kind of limits its appeal.

These new rules you have to be aware of are for opening Chase Business cards (including co-branded) as a sole proprietor. If you are applying as a sole prop rather than with an LLC using an EIN, then you will have to be at 2/24 or below to give yourself the best chances of approval. Meaning that you can only have opened 2 personal credit cards ACROSS ANY BANK in the last 24 months. If you have opened 3 or more, then Chase has been denying most sole props. If you apply with an LLC/EIN, it appears that the rule is still 5/24.
Adam Seper Thank you for this information. So, would it be possible to double dip with both your SSN/EIN and LLC/EIN?

Potentially. I have done it myself and have seen DPs of others getting the SUB on the same card with a sole prop and an LLC/EIN, but it’s definitely not guaranteed. But since they generally give you the popup if you’re ineligible, you can try without getting a hard pull on your credit and then just pull the application if you’re not eligible for the SUB.
